description: 電力及燃氣供應業廠商職缺僱用條件概況-按職類及員工規模分 [electricity and power and gas networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 行政院主計總處. 事業人力僱用狀況調查之電力及燃氣供應業廠商職缺僱用條件概況，並按職類及員工規模發布. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 行政院主計總處. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-09-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
